title: #billing-ops: Enterprise 30-Day Evaluation Refund Procedure
content: Dave (Billing Dev): Quick note for support: if an Enterprise account on an MSA asks for a refund within 30 days, do NOT auto-reject under the 14-day rule. Enterprise sales contracts include a 30-day evaluation rider managed in Salesforce. Route to escalations.
author: Dave (Billing Dev)

title: #billing-general: Annual Subscription Pro-Rating Clarification
content: Elena (Billing Lead): We are getting questions about mid-term cancellations. Per executive policy, annual subscriptions are sold at a 20% discount upfront and cannot be pro-rated or refunded after day 14. Cancellation simply stops auto-renewal at end of period.
author: Elena (Billing Lead)

title: #engineering: Stripe Webhook Duplicate Charge Incident
content: Marcus (Platform Eng): Heads up team, during yesterday's Stripe webhook migration, an idempotency key misconfiguration caused roughly 18 accounts to be charged twice. Billing ops has voided all duplicate authorizations. Idempotency layer is now patched.
author: Marcus (Platform Eng)

title: #ops-incidents: 2025 SLA Automatic Credit Implementation
content: Dan (SRE Lead): Team, reminder that starting Jan 1 2025, our SLA credit calculation changed. Under the 2024 SLA, customers had to manually open a ticket within 30 days for a 10% credit. In 2025 SLA revision, if monthly uptime drops below 99.95%, our billing pipeline automatically applies 15% credit.
author: Dan (SRE Lead)

title: #product-discussions: 2024 vs 2025 SLA Grandfathering Policy
content: Sarah (Support Lead): What happens to enterprise contracts signed before 2025? Dan (SRE): Contracts signed prior to Jan 1 2025 follow their signed 2024 SLA terms (99.9% uptime, 10% credit upon manual claim) until renewal. All new 2025 contracts get 99.95% / 15% auto.
author: Dan (SRE Lead)

title: #announcements: Release v2.4 Security Notice - CSV Export Removal
content: VP Engineering: Release v2.4 is deployed to production. Notice: CSV export has been permanently removed due to CSV injection vulnerabilities (formula execution in Microsoft Excel). Only JSON and Parquet formats are supported moving forward.
author: VP Engineering

title: #support-internal: Workaround for Clients Demanding CSV Data
content: Alex (Tech Support): For clients whose accounting software still demands CSV, share the snippet from docs/scripts/json_to_csv_converter.py. They can export JSON via API and run the python script locally on their trusted machine.
author: Alex (Tech Support)

title: #billing-ops: Dunning and Payment Failure Grace Period
content: Elena (Billing Lead): When a card fails on subscription renewal, the account does NOT lock immediately. We grant a 72-hour grace period with retries at 24h, 48h, and 72h. If unresolved at 72 hours, account is downgraded to read-only.
author: Elena (Billing Lead)

title: #infra-architecture: Kafka Sizing Constraints for Self-Hosted Deployments
content: Vikram (Architect): Critical reminder for enterprise architects: Kafka clusters deployed on-premise must have minimum 3 brokers in distinct availability zones. Running 2 brokers causes quorum lock during single-node restarts.
author: Vikram (Architect)

title: #backend-dev: SQLite Search Index Maintenance Schedule
content: Priya (DBA): The SQLite FTS5 search index rebuild task runs nightly at 02:00 UTC via cron. If queries appear to lag behind newly ingested records by a few seconds, that is normal debounce buffering.
author: Priya (DBA)

title: #api-guild: API Rate Limiting Quotas and Tier Headers
content: Alex (Tech Support): Standard tier is capped at 1,000 req/min, while Enterprise tier gets 5,000 req/min. Both return X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining HTTP response headers.
author: Alex (Tech Support)

title: #watercooler: False Rumor Regarding CSV Export Return
content: Junior Dev: Hey, I heard someone say CSV export is coming back in release v2.6 with sanitization? VP Engineering: Absolutely not true. That rumor was debunked in security council. CSV is deprecated permanently. Do not tell clients otherwise.
author: VP Engineering

title: #security-ops: Okta & Azure AD SAML 2.0 Integration Support
content: Sarah (Support Lead): Customer is asking if we support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta SAML 2.0 SSO. Yes, both are fully supported on Enterprise tier. ACS URL and Entity ID are available in the Security Settings tab.
author: Sarah (Support Lead)

title: #billing-ops: Currency Precision Edge Case for Indian Rupee (INR)
content: Elena (Billing Lead): Edge case note: When processing INR transactions, ensure razorpay webhook handles paise without sub-unit truncation. We had a 2-paise rounding discrepancy reported on Ticket #10840.
author: Elena (Billing Lead)

title: #research-speculation: Quantum Key Distribution Exploration (Future)
content: Research Scientist Leo: Wondering if our roadmap will ever explore quantum key distribution or post-quantum lattice cryptography? VP Engineering: Not in our 2025 or 2026 roadmap. There are zero production features or plugins for quantum encryption.
author: VP Engineering
